```sql
WITH recent AS (
    -- Filter tariff_windows
    SELECT
        id,
        valid_from,
        valid_to,
        rate,
        INITCAP(TRIM(tariff)) AS tariff_clean,
        ABS(rate - 5.5) AS rate_distance
    FROM tariff_windows
    WHERE TO_DATE(valid_to) < DATE '2025-03-12'
),
rollup_base AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(valid_from) AS valid_from_day,
        CASE WHEN rate >= 5.9 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN rate >= 3.7 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END AS rate_tier,
        DATE_FORMAT(valid_to, 'yyyy-MM') AS valid_to_ym,
        MAX(rate) AS max_rate,
        ROUND(AVG(rate_distance), 2) AS avg_rate_distance,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        MIN(valid_to) AS first_valid_to,
        MAX(valid_to) AS last_valid_to
    FROM recent
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
scored AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN avg_rate_distance >= 4.8 THEN 'large' WHEN avg_rate_distance >= 1.6 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'small' END AS avg_rate_distance_tier,
        TO_DATE(first_valid_to) AS first_valid_to_date
    FROM rollup_base
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        valid_from_day,
        rate_tier,
        valid_to_ym,
        max_rate,
        avg_rate_distance,
        first_valid_to,
        last_valid_to,
        first_valid_to_date,
        TO_DATE(last_valid_to) AS last_valid_to_date
    FROM scored
),
ranked AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        valid_from_day,
        rate_tier,
        valid_to_ym,
        max_rate,
        avg_rate_distance,
        first_valid_to,
        last_valid_to,
        first_valid_to_date,
        last_valid_to_date,
        ROUND(avg_rate_distance - AVG(avg_rate_distance) OVER w_first_valid_to_date_year, 2) AS avg_rate_distance_vs_first_valid_to_date_year_av,
        MIN(avg_rate_distance) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(first_valid_to_date)) AS first_valid_to_date_year_min_avg_rate_distance,
        ROUND(AVG(max_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_valid_to_date) ORDER BY last_valid_to, valid_from_day, rate_tier, valid_to_ym ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS max_rate_avg_3,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_last_valid_to_date_month_by_2, 3) AS last_valid_to_percent_rank
    FROM tagged
    WINDOW w_first_valid_to_date_year AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(first_valid_to_date)), w_last_valid_to_date_month_by_2 AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_valid_to_date) ORDER BY last_valid_to, valid_from_day, rate_tier, valid_to_ym)
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        valid_from_day,
        rate_tier,
        valid_to_ym,
        max_rate,
        avg_rate_distance,
        first_valid_to,
        first_valid_to_date,
        avg_rate_distance_vs_first_valid_to_date_year_av,
        max_rate_avg_3,
        last_valid_to_percent_rank,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_valid_to_date) ORDER BY last_valid_to_percent_rank), 3) AS last_valid_to_percent_rank_cume_dist,
        ROUND(AVG(max_rate_avg_3) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(first_valid_to_date), TO_DATE(last_valid_to)), 2) AS first_valid_to_date_month_last_valid_to_to_date_,
        max_rate - LAG(max_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_valid_to_date) ORDER BY last_valid_to_percent_rank, valid_from_day, rate_tier, valid_to_ym) AS max_rate_change,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(rate_tier) OVER w_first_valid_to_date_month_la) AS distinct_rate_tier_in_first_valid_to_date_month_
    FROM ranked
    WINDOW w_first_valid_to_date_month_la AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(first_valid_to_date), TO_DATE(last_valid_to))
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall avg
    SELECT *
    FROM windowed
    WHERE max_rate_change > (SELECT AVG(max_rate_change) FROM windowed)
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT (long to wide)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT valid_from_day, rate_tier, max_rate_change
    FROM with_activity
) src
PIVOT (
    SUM(max_rate_change)
    FOR rate_tier IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM')
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

recent = (
    df_tariff_windows
    .filter(F.to_date(F.col("valid_to")) < F.lit("2025-03-12").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "valid_from",
        "valid_to",
        "rate",
        F.initcap(F.trim(F.col("tariff"))).alias("tariff_clean"),
        F.abs(F.col("rate") - 5.5).alias("rate_distance"),
    )
)

rollup_base = (
    recent
    .groupBy(
        F.to_date("valid_from").alias("valid_from_day"),
        F.when(F.col("rate") >= 5.9, "HIGH").when(F.col("rate") >= 3.7, "MEDIUM").otherwise("LOW").alias("rate_tier"),
        F.date_format("valid_to", "yyyy-MM").alias("valid_to_ym"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("rate").alias("max_rate"),
        F.round(F.avg("rate_distance"), 2).alias("avg_rate_distance"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.min("valid_to").alias("first_valid_to"),
        F.max("valid_to").alias("last_valid_to"),
    )
)

scored = (
    rollup_base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("avg_rate_distance") >= 4.8, "large").when(F.col("avg_rate_distance") >= 1.6, "medium").otherwise("small").alias("avg_rate_distance_tier"),
        F.to_date(F.col("first_valid_to")).alias("first_valid_to_date"),
    )
)

tagged = (
    scored
    .select(
        "valid_from_day",
        "rate_tier",
        "valid_to_ym",
        "max_rate",
        "avg_rate_distance",
        "first_valid_to",
        "last_valid_to",
        "first_valid_to_date",
        F.to_date(F.col("last_valid_to")).alias("last_valid_to_date"),
    )
)

w_first_valid_to_date_year = Window.partitionBy(F.year("first_valid_to_date"))
w_last_valid_to_date_month_by_2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_valid_to_date")).orderBy("last_valid_to", "valid_from_day", "rate_tier", "valid_to_ym")
ranked = (
    tagged
    .select(
        "valid_from_day",
        "rate_tier",
        "valid_to_ym",
        "max_rate",
        "avg_rate_distance",
        "first_valid_to",
        "last_valid_to",
        "first_valid_to_date",
        "last_valid_to_date",
        F.round(F.col("avg_rate_distance") - F.avg("avg_rate_distance").over(w_first_valid_to_date_year), 2).alias("avg_rate_distance_vs_first_valid_to_date_year_av"),
        F.min("avg_rate_distance").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("first_valid_to_date"))).alias("first_valid_to_date_year_min_avg_rate_distance"),
        F.round(F.avg("max_rate").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_valid_to_date")).orderBy("last_valid_to", "valid_from_day", "rate_tier", "valid_to_ym").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)), 2).alias("max_rate_avg_3"),
        F.round(F.percent_rank().over(w_last_valid_to_date_month_by_2), 3).alias("last_valid_to_percent_rank"),
    )
)

w_first_valid_to_date_month_la = Window.partitionBy(F.month("first_valid_to_date"), F.to_date("last_valid_to"))
windowed = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "valid_from_day",
        "rate_tier",
        "valid_to_ym",
        "max_rate",
        "avg_rate_distance",
        "first_valid_to",
        "first_valid_to_date",
        "avg_rate_distance_vs_first_valid_to_date_year_av",
        "max_rate_avg_3",
        "last_valid_to_percent_rank",
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_valid_to_date")).orderBy("last_valid_to_percent_rank")), 3).alias("last_valid_to_percent_rank_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.avg("max_rate_avg_3").over(Window.partitionBy(F.month("first_valid_to_date"), F.to_date("last_valid_to"))), 2).alias("first_valid_to_date_month_last_valid_to_to_date_"),
        (F.col("max_rate") - F.lag("max_rate").over(Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_valid_to_date")).orderBy("last_valid_to_percent_rank", "valid_from_day", "rate_tier", "valid_to_ym"))).alias("max_rate_change"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("rate_tier").over(w_first_valid_to_date_month_la)).alias("distinct_rate_tier_in_first_valid_to_date_month_"),
    )
)

with_activity = (
    windowed
    .crossJoin(windowed.agg(F.avg("max_rate_change").alias("overall_avg_max_rate_change")))
    .filter(F.col("max_rate_change") > F.col("overall_avg_max_rate_change"))
    .drop("overall_avg_max_rate_change")
)

result = (
    with_activity
    .groupBy("valid_from_day")
    .pivot("rate_tier", ["LOW", "MEDIUM"])
    .agg(F.sum("max_rate_change"))
)
```

```sql
WITH scoped_events AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        event_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES AS event_at_plus_30m
    FROM ticket_events
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per event_type
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM scoped_events
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        event_type,
        session_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY event_type, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    event_type,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
ORDER BY event_type NULLS LAST, session_id
LIMIT 10
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_events = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        (F.col("event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")).alias("event_at_plus_30m"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_events.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("event_type", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "event_type",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "duration_min",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_type").asc_nulls_last(), "session_id")
    .limit(10)
)
```

```sql
WITH valid AS (
    -- Scope the tickets rows
    SELECT
        id,
        requester_id,
        agent_id,
        opened_at,
        closed_at,
        priority,
        channel,
        csat
    FROM tickets
    WHERE priority IN ('P2', 'P1', 'P4')
      AND requester_id < 18
),
exploded_detail AS (
    -- One row per event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.priority,
        s.csat,
        t.id AS event_id,
        t.event_type,
        t.actor AS event_actor,
        t.event_at
    FROM valid s
    JOIN ticket_events t ON t.ticket_id = s.id
),
with_parent_agent AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.opened_at,
        s.priority,
        s.event_id,
        s.event_type,
        s.event_at,
        su.hired_on AS agent_hired_on
    FROM exploded_detail s
    JOIN support_agents su ON su.id = s.agent_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach tickets metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MIN(t.closed_at) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS first_ticket_closed_at,
        (SELECT MAX(t.opened_at) FROM tickets t WHERE t.agent_id = s.agent_id) AS last_ticket_opened_at
    FROM with_parent_agent s
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id, TO_DATE(opened_at) ORDER BY agent_hired_on, id, event_id) AS agent_hired_on_decile,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY last_ticket_opened_at DESC), 3) AS last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY last_ticket_opened_at DESC, id, event_id), 3) AS last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_agent_id_opened_at_to_date_b AS seq_no
    FROM with_stats
    WINDOW w_agent_id_opened_at_to_date_b AS (PARTITION BY agent_id, TO_DATE(opened_at) ORDER BY agent_hired_on, id, event_id)
),
with_children AS (
    -- One row per event
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.agent_id,
        s.event_id,
        s.event_type,
        s.event_at,
        s.first_ticket_closed_at,
        s.last_ticket_opened_at,
        s.agent_hired_on_decile,
        s.last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist,
        s.last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist_2,
        t.id AS event_id_2,
        t.actor AS event_actor,
        t.event_type AS event_event_type
    FROM sequenced s
    LEFT JOIN ticket_events t ON t.ticket_id = s.id
),
screened AS (
    -- Rows with no matching ticket_events
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_children s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM ticket_events t
            WHERE t.ticket_id = s.id
              AND t.event_type = 'escalated'
        )
)
SELECT
    agent_hired_on_decile,
    event_id_2,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('reopened', 'resolved') THEN last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist ELSE 0 END) AS last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist_event_type_in_re,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_actor IN ('customer', 'system') THEN agent_hired_on_decile ELSE 0 END) AS agent_hired_on_decile_event_actor_in_customer_sy,
    ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN event_actor = 'agent' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_event_actor_agent
FROM screened
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((agent_hired_on_decile, event_id_2), (agent_hired_on_decile), (event_id_2))
ORDER BY agent_hired_on_decile NULLS LAST, event_id_2 NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

valid = (
    df_tickets
    .filter((F.col("priority").isin("P2", "P1", "P4")) & (F.col("requester_id") < 18))
    .select(
        "id",
        "requester_id",
        "agent_id",
        "opened_at",
        "closed_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "csat",
    )
)

exploded_detail = (
    valid.alias("s")
    .join(df_ticket_events.alias("t"), F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.opened_at",
        "s.priority",
        "s.csat",
        F.col("t.id").alias("event_id"),
        "t.event_type",
        F.col("t.actor").alias("event_actor"),
        "t.event_at",
    )
)

with_parent_agent = (
    exploded_detail.alias("s")
    .join(df_support_agents.alias("su"), F.col("su.id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.opened_at",
        "s.priority",
        "s.event_id",
        "s.event_type",
        "s.event_at",
        F.col("su.hired_on").alias("agent_hired_on"),
    )
)

ticket_stats = (
    df_tickets
    .groupBy("agent_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("closed_at").alias("first_ticket_closed_at"),
        F.max("opened_at").alias("last_ticket_opened_at"),

)

with_stats = (
    with_parent_agent.alias("s")
    .join(ticket_stats.alias("t"), F.col("t.agent_id") == F.col("s.agent_id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", "t.first_ticket_closed_at", "t.last_ticket_opened_at")
)

w_agent_id_opened_at_to_date_b = Window.partitionBy("agent_id", F.to_date("opened_at")).orderBy("agent_hired_on", "id", "event_id")
sequenced = (
    with_stats
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("agent_id", F.to_date("opened_at")).orderBy("agent_hired_on", "id", "event_id")).alias("agent_hired_on_decile"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last_ticket_opened_at").desc())), 3).alias("last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist"),
        F.round(F.cume_dist().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last_ticket_opened_at").desc(), "id", "event_id")), 3).alias("last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w_agent_id_opened_at_to_date_b).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

with_children = (
    sequenced.alias("s")
    .join(df_ticket_events.alias("t"), F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.agent_id",
        "s.event_id",
        "s.event_type",
        "s.event_at",
        "s.first_ticket_closed_at",
        "s.last_ticket_opened_at",
        "s.agent_hired_on_decile",
        "s.last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist",
        "s.last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist_2",
        F.col("t.id").alias("event_id_2"),
        F.col("t.actor").alias("event_actor"),
        F.col("t.event_type").alias("event_event_type"),
    )
)

screened = (
    with_children.alias("s")
    .join(df_ticket_events.alias("t"), (F.col("t.ticket_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("t.event_type") == "escalated"), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    screened
    .groupingSets(
        [["agent_hired_on_decile", "event_id_2"], ["agent_hired_on_decile"], ["event_id_2"]],
        "agent_hired_on_decile", "event_id_2",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_type").isin("reopened", "resolved"), F.col("last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist")).otherwise(0)).alias("last_ticket_opened_at_cume_dist_event_type_in_re"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("event_actor").isin("customer", "system"), F.col("agent_hired_on_decile")).otherwise(0)).alias("agent_hired_on_decile_event_actor_in_customer_sy"),
        F.round(100 * F.count(F.when(F.col("event_actor") == "agent", 1)) / F.count("*"), 1).alias("pct_event_actor_agent"),
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("agent_hired_on_decile").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("event_id_2").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH prepared_moves AS (
    -- Filter stock_moves
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        qty,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        unit_price,
        DAYOFWEEK(moved_at) AS moved_at_dayofweek,
        LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(operator), ' ', '_')) AS operator_slug
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE warehouse_id >= 3
),
with_parent_sku AS (
    -- Enrich with dimension data
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.qty,
        s.moved_at_dayofweek,
        s.operator_slug,
        sk.unit_cost AS sku_unit_cost,
        sk.sku_code,
        w.capacity AS warehouse_capacity
    FROM prepared_moves s
    LEFT JOIN skus sk ON sk.id = s.sku_id
    LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id
),
move_stats AS (
    -- Per-warehouse stock_moves metrics
    SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        COUNT(*) AS move_count,
        COUNT(*) AS move_count_2,
        COUNT(*) AS move_count_3
    FROM stock_moves
    GROUP BY warehouse_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach stock_moves metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(st.move_count, 0) AS move_count,
        COALESCE(st.move_count_2, 0) AS move_count_2,
        COALESCE(st.move_count_3, 0) AS move_count_3
    FROM with_parent_sku s
    LEFT JOIN move_stats st ON st.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
),
line_level AS (
    -- One row per move
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_unit_cost,
        s.warehouse_capacity,
        s.move_count,
        st.id AS move_id,
        st.warehouse_id AS move_warehouse_id,
        st.operator AS move_operator,
        st.move_type
    FROM with_stats s
    LEFT JOIN stock_moves st ON st.sku_id = s.sku_id
),
joined_sku AS (
    -- Attach sku attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.warehouse_id,
        s.sku_id,
        s.sku_unit_cost,
        s.warehouse_capacity,
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        quality,
        burst_id,
        MIN(read_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(read_at) AS session_end,

        SUM(voltage) AS session_voltage,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

)

    burst_id,
    session_start,
    n_events,
    session_voltage,
    duration_min,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', session_end) AS days_since_session_end
FROM per_session
```

```sql
        ROUND(AVG(kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id, quality), 2) AS site_id_quality_avg_kwh,
        ROUND(voltage / NULLIF(SUM(voltage) OVER (PARTITION BY quality), 0), 4) AS voltage_share_of_quality,
        ROUND(voltage - AVG(voltage) OVER w_site_id_quality, 2) AS voltage_vs_site_id_quality_avg,
        ROUND(PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_site_id_quality_by_voltage, 3) AS voltage_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_all_by_kwh AS kwh_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY kwh DESC) AS kwh_dense_rank_2
    FROM recent_readings
    WINDOW w_all_by_kwh AS (ORDER BY kwh DESC, id), w_site_id_quality AS (PARTITION BY site_id, quality), w_site_id_quality_by_voltage AS (PARTITION BY site_id, quality ORDER BY voltage DESC, id)
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    kwh,
    quality,
    next_voltage,
    kwh_seq,
    voltage_change,
    site_id_quality_avg_kwh,
    voltage_share_of_quality,
    voltage_vs_site_id_quality_avg,
    kwh_dense_rank,
    kwh_dense_rank_2,
    CASE WHEN quality IN ('OK', 'EST') THEN 'group_a' WHEN quality = 'BAD' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS quality_group,
    kwh_seq + kwh AS kwh_seq_plus_kwh
FROM sequenced
ORDER BY kwh DESC, voltage_change, id
LIMIT 5
```

```sql
with_trends AS (

        *,

    WINDOW w_quality_by_read_at AS (PARTITION BY quality ORDER BY read_at ASC, id)

windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions

        id,
        site_id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        voltage,
        quality,
        quality_group,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_quality_quality_group AS rows_in_quality_quality_group,
        ROUND(AVG(prev_kwh) OVER (PARTITION BY quality, quality_group), 2) AS quality_quality_group_avg_prev_kwh,
        LEAD(kwh, 3) OVER (ORDER BY voltage_change, id) AS next3_kwh
    FROM with_trends
    WINDOW w_quality_quality_group AS (PARTITION BY quality, quality_group)
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Compare against the overall max
    SELECT *
    FROM windowed
    WHERE kwh < (SELECT MAX(kwh) FROM windowed)
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

    FROM sessions
```

```sql
        SUM(b.approved_amount) AS prior_approved_amount_180d
    FROM claims a
    LEFT JOIN claims b
      ON b.policy_id = a.policy_id
     AND b.claim_date < a.claim_date
     AND b.claim_date >= DATE_SUB(a.claim_date, 180)
    GROUP BY a.id, a.policy_id, a.claim_date
),
stats AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        policy_id,
        ROUND(SUM(prior_approved_amount_180d) / NULLIF(SUM(prior_rows_180d), 0), 3) AS prior_approved_amount_180d_to_prior_rows_180d_ra,
        MAX(claim_date) AS last_claim_date,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM covered
    GROUP BY 1
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        policy_id,
        last_claim_date,
        cnt,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY last_claim_date DESC NULLS FIRST, policy_id) AS last_claim_date_dense_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(last_claim_date) OVER (ORDER BY last_claim_date DESC NULLS FIRST, policy_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_last_claim_date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_all_by_last_claim_date AS last_claim_date_seq
    FROM stats
    WINDOW w_all_by_last_claim_date AS (ORDER BY last_claim_date DESC NULLS FIRST, policy_id)
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(last_claim_date_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY cnt, policy_id) AS cnt_policy_id_min_last_claim_date_seq,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY last_last_claim_date ASC, policy_id) AS last_last_claim_date_rank,
        LAG(last_last_claim_date) OVER (ORDER BY last_last_claim_date ASC, policy_id) AS prev_last_last_claim_date,
        SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC, policy_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cnt_sum_1_prior
    FROM sequenced
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    policy_id,
    last_claim_date,
    last_claim_date_dense_rank,
    last_last_claim_date,
    prev_last_last_claim_date,
    cnt_sum_1_prior,
    DATEDIFF(last_last_claim_date, last_claim_date) AS days_last_claim_date_to_last_last_claim_date,
    LEAST(cnt, last_claim_date_seq) AS least_cnt_last_claim_date_seq
FROM with_trends
ORDER BY least_cnt_last_claim_date_seq DESC NULLS FIRST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

covered = (
    df_claims.alias("a")
    .join(
        df_claims.alias("b"),
        (F.col("b.policy_id") == F.col("a.policy_id"))
        & (F.col("b.claim_date") < F.col("a.claim_date"))
        & (F.col("b.claim_date") >= F.date_sub(F.col("a.claim_date"), 180)),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.policy_id", "a.claim_date")
    .agg(
        F.count("b.id").alias("prior_rows_180d"),
        F.sum("b.approved_amount").alias("prior_approved_amount_180d"),
    )
)

stats = (
    covered
    .groupBy("policy_id")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("prior_approved_amount_180d") / F.nullif(F.sum("prior_rows_180d"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("prior_approved_amount_180d_to_prior_rows_180d_ra"),
        F.max("claim_date").alias("last_claim_date"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)

w_all_by_last_claim_date = Window.orderBy(F.col("last_claim_date").desc_nulls_first(), "policy_id")
sequenced = (
    stats
    .select(
        "policy_id",
        "last_claim_date",
        "cnt",
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last_claim_date").desc_nulls_first(), "policy_id")).alias("last_claim_date_dense_rank"),
        F.last("last_claim_date").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("last_claim_date").desc_nulls_first(), "policy_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_last_claim_date"),
        F.row_number().over(w_all_by_last_claim_date).alias("last_claim_date_seq"),
    )
)

with_trends = (
    sequenced
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("last_claim_date_seq").over(Window.partitionBy("cnt", "policy_id")).alias("cnt_policy_id_min_last_claim_date_seq"),
        F.rank().over(Window.orderBy("last_last_claim_date", "policy_id")).alias("last_last_claim_date_rank"),
        F.lag("last_last_claim_date").over(Window.orderBy("last_last_claim_date", "policy_id")).alias("prev_last_last_claim_date"),
        F.sum("cnt").over(Window.partitionBy("cnt").orderBy(F.col("cnt").desc(), "policy_id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)).alias("cnt_sum_1_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_trends
    .select(
        "policy_id",
        "last_claim_date",
        "last_claim_date_dense_rank",
        "last_last_claim_date",
        "prev_last_last_claim_date",
        "cnt_sum_1_prior",
        F.datediff(F.col("last_last_claim_date"), F.col("last_claim_date")).alias("days_last_claim_date_to_last_last_claim_date"),
        F.least(F.col("cnt"), F.col("last_claim_date_seq")).alias("least_cnt_last_claim_date_seq"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("least_cnt_last_claim_date_seq").desc_nulls_first())
```

```sql
WITH in_window AS (
    -- Count earlier rows of the same key inside the look-back window
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.site_id,
        a.read_at,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_1d,
        SUM(b.voltage) AS prior_voltage_1d
    FROM meter_readings a
    LEFT JOIN meter_readings b
      ON b.site_id = a.site_id
     AND b.read_at < a.read_at
     AND b.read_at >= a.read_at - INTERVAL 1 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.site_id, a.read_at
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER w_all_by_prior_rows_1d AS prior_rows_1d_tercile,
        ROUND(prior_rows_1d / NULLIF(SUM(prior_rows_1d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d, YEAR(read_at)), 0), 4) AS prior_rows_1d_share_of_prior_rows_1d_read_at_yea,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(read_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(LAG(read_at) OVER w_all_by_prior_rows_1d)) / 60, 1) AS minutes_since_prev_read_at
    FROM in_window
    WINDOW w_all_by_prior_rows_1d AS (ORDER BY prior_rows_1d ASC, id)
),
site_id_stats AS (
    -- Median prior_voltage_1d per site_id
    SELECT site_id, PERCENTILE_APPROX(prior_voltage_1d, 0.5) AS median_prior_voltage_1d
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY site_id
),
vs_group AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.median_prior_voltage_1d,
        ROUND(s.prior_voltage_1d - g.median_prior_voltage_1d, 2) AS prior_voltage_1d_minus_median
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN site_id_stats g ON g.site_id = s.site_id
    WHERE s.prior_voltage_1d >= g.median_prior_voltage_1d
),
sequenced AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d, prior_rows_1d_tercile) AS rows_in_prior_rows_1d_prior_rows_1d_tercile,
        ROUND(median_prior_voltage_1d / NULLIF(SUM(median_prior_voltage_1d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d, prior_rows_1d_tercile), 0), 4) AS median_prior_voltage_1d_share_of_prior_rows_1d_p,
        ROUND(AVG(median_prior_voltage_1d) OVER (PARTITION BY prior_rows_1d ORDER BY prior_rows_1d DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS median_prior_voltage_1d_avg_2
    FROM vs_group
)

FROM sequenced
```

```python
in_window = (
    df_meter_readings.alias("a")
    .join(

        & (F.col("b.read_at") >= F.col("a.read_at") - F.expr("INTERVAL 1 DAYS")),
        "left",
    )
    .groupBy("a.id", "a.site_id", "a.read_at")
    .agg(

    )

with_windows = (

    .select(
        "*",
```

```python
        F.when(F.col("operator").isin("op_ann", "op_bee"), "group_a").when(F.col("operator") == "op_eve", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("operator_group"),
    )
)
```

```sql
    FROM base

    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY warehouse_id ORDER BY moved_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        warehouse_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY warehouse_id, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    warehouse_id,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY listener_id ORDER BY played_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (

    SELECT
        listener_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(played_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(played_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS n_events,
        SUM(ms_played) AS session_ms_played,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(played_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(played_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY listener_id, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    listener_id,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    n_events,
    session_ms_played,
    duration_min,
    n_events + session_ms_played AS n_events_plus_session_ms_played
FROM sessions
ORDER BY session_id
```

```sql
        r.id,
        r.site_id,

        st.zone,

    FROM meter_readings r
    JOIN sites st ON st.id = r.site_id
    JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to

with_activity AS (

    SELECT s.*
    FROM in_window s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM sites si
            WHERE si.id = s.site_id
              AND UPPER(TRIM(si.site_name)) LIKE 'D%'
              AND si.tariff NOT IN ('TOU', 'FLAT')
        )
),
summarized_rows AS (
    -- Attach meter_readings metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        (SELECT MAX(m.kwh) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS max_reading_kwh,
        (SELECT MIN(m.read_at) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS first_reading_read_at,
        (SELECT MAX(m.read_at) FROM meter_readings m WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id) AS last_reading_read_at
    FROM with_activity s
),
qualified AS (
    -- Rows that have matching meter_readings
    SELECT s.*
    FROM summarized_rows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM meter_readings m
            WHERE m.site_id = s.site_id
              AND m.quality = 'BAD'
        )
      AND s.rate > 4.2
)
-- Final projection

    read_at,
    kwh,
    voltage,

FROM qualified
```

```sql
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.policy_id,
        a.claim_date,
        COUNT(b.id) AS prior_rows_30d,
        SUM(b.claimed_amount) AS prior_claimed_amount_30d
    FROM claims a
    LEFT JOIN claims b
      ON b.policy_id = a.policy_id
     AND b.claim_date < a.claim_date
     AND b.claim_date >= DATE_SUB(a.claim_date, 30)
    GROUP BY a.id, a.policy_id, a.claim_date
),
claim_stats AS (
    -- Per-policy claims metrics
    SELECT policy_id, MAX(claim_date) AS last_claim_date, COUNT(*) AS claim_count
    FROM claims
    GROUP BY policy_id
),
with_counts AS (
    -- Attach claims metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        c.last_claim_date,
        COALESCE(c.claim_count, 0) AS claim_count
    FROM covered s
    LEFT JOIN claim_stats c ON c.policy_id = s.policy_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        policy_id,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        ROUND(STDDEV(prior_rows_30d), 2) AS stddev_prior_rows_30d

    WHERE claim_count > 4
    GROUP BY policy_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    policy_id,
    n_rows,
    stddev_prior_rows_30d + n_rows AS stddev_prior_rows_30d_plus_n_rows,
    FLOOR(n_rows / 2) * 2 AS n_rows_bucket
FROM summary
ORDER BY n_rows DESC NULLS FIRST, stddev_prior_rows_30d_plus_n_rows DESC NULLS FIRST, policy_id
```

```sql
sessionized AS (

        SUM(kwh) AS session_kwh,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(read_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(read_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
```

```sql
    FROM flagged

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

labeled AS (

    FROM sessions
```

```sql
    -- Price each reading with the tariff window it falls into
    SELECT
        r.id,
        r.site_id,
        r.read_at,
        r.kwh,
        r.voltage,
        st.zone,
        tw.rate,
        ROUND(r.kwh * tw.rate, 2) AS energy_cost
    FROM meter_readings r
    JOIN sites st ON st.id = r.site_id
    LEFT JOIN tariff_windows tw
      ON tw.tariff = st.tariff
     AND r.read_at >= tw.valid_from
     AND r.read_at < tw.valid_to
),
enriched AS (
    -- Label and score rows
    SELECT
        id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        zone,
        energy_cost,
        COALESCE(kwh, 0.0) AS kwh_filled,
        CASE WHEN zone IN ('Z4', 'Z3') THEN 'group_a' WHEN zone = 'Z2' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS zone_group
    FROM joined_ranges
),
with_trends AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        id,
        read_at,
        kwh,
        energy_cost,
        kwh_filled,
        LEAD(energy_cost, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY zone, zone_group ORDER BY read_at, id) AS next_energy_cost,
        energy_cost - LAG(energy_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY zone, zone_group ORDER BY read_at, id) AS energy_cost_change
    FROM enriched
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    id,
    read_at,
    energy_cost,
    kwh_filled,
    energy_cost_change,
    ABS(next_energy_cost - 315.0) AS next_energy_cost_distance
FROM with_trends
WHERE kwh >= 48.2
ORDER BY energy_cost_change, next_energy_cost_distance
```

```sql
        LEAD(reported_at, 2) OVER w_all_by_reported_at AS next2_reported_at

    SELECT
```

```sql
    -- Scope the enrollments rows
    SELECT
        id,
        student_id,
        course_id,
        term,
        score,
        enrolled_at,
        LENGTH(TRIM(term)) AS term_len
    FROM enrollments

with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per student_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM recent
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
session_summary AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        student_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY student_id, session_id
),
tagged AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT *, DATE_FORMAT(session_end, 'MMM yyyy') AS session_end_label
    FROM session_summary
)
SELECT
    student_id,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    events,
    session_end_label
FROM tagged
ORDER BY session_start DESC
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
enriched AS (
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

    FROM flagged
```

```sql
        session_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized

    duration_min,
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY course_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged

sessions AS (

        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,

        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY course_id, burst_id
)

    burst_id,
    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min,
    TO_DATE(session_end) AS session_end_date,
```

```sql
        SUM(b.requester_id) AS prior_requester_id_3d
    FROM tickets a
    LEFT JOIN tickets b
      ON b.agent_id = a.agent_id
     AND b.opened_at < a.opened_at
     AND b.opened_at >= a.opened_at - INTERVAL 3 DAYS
    GROUP BY a.id, a.agent_id, a.opened_at

    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        *,

        FIRST_VALUE(opened_at) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(opened_at) ORDER BY opened_at NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_opened_at,
        ROUND(AVG(prior_rows_3d) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(opened_at) ORDER BY opened_at NULLS LAST, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS prior_rows_3d_avg_2
    FROM matched

agent_id_stats AS (

    FROM sequenced
    GROUP BY agent_id
),
compared AS (

        s.*,
        g.median_prior_requester_id_3d,
        ROUND(s.prior_requester_id_3d - g.median_prior_requester_id_3d, 2) AS prior_requester_id_3d_minus_median
    FROM sequenced s

    WHERE s.prior_requester_id_3d >= g.median_prior_requester_id_3d
```

```sql
    FROM flagged
```

```sql
session_summary AS (
```

```sql
        ticket_id,
```

```python
    .orderBy(F.col("prior_rows_12h").asc(), "seq_no")
)
```
